# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** 13–15 years old  <sub>[v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v2 c28 P67](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0067)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden / Domestic Servant  <sub>[v1 c21 P40](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0040), [v2 c21 P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Titles:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>; Leonora  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta is a freckled, snub-nosed girl with a very wide, cheerful smile and fair hair braided into two long tails. She habitually wears two enormous blue ribbon bows on her hair, which she later expands to four when dressing up for special occasions. Despite her attempts to copy Anne Shirley's grace, she retains her plump and brisk physical presence.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c28 P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)_

## Personality

Charlotta is an energetic, loyal, and bustling girl who approaches her work with intense devotion. She is deeply attached to her employer and eager to please her, never objecting to her whimsical ways. Though practical, candid, and prone to worry about things going wrong, she possesses a lively humor and a strong sense of duty.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P40](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0040), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P16](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0016)_

## History

Born Leonora Bowman, she entered the service of Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge at the age of thirteen. Because her three older sisters—Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina—had previously held the same position and looked virtually identical, Miss Lavendar dubbed her 'Charlotta the Fourth.' Charlotta quickly developed a deep affection for her mistress, assisting her with chores and willingly participating in her imaginative pretenses. When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry visited Echo Lodge, Charlotta befriended them and formed a deep admiration for Anne, secretly trying to imitate her manners. Later, when Stephen Irving returned to court Miss Lavendar, Charlotta eagerly supported the romance and fretted over its outcome. Following Miss Lavendar and Stephen's marriage in the garden at Echo Lodge, Charlotta prepared to move to Boston with them, thrilled to be going at fifteen instead of sixteen like her sisters.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v2 c21 P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P76](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0076)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest of four sisters who sequentially worked for Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She was hired at age thirteen to live at Echo Lodge for board and clothes  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Her sisters all left for Boston upon turning sixteen  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

> They're not things that go by habit. They just happen... and there you are. Anybody can have a stroke.  <sub>[v1 c19 P49](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0049)</sub>

> It's plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I'm too forward, Miss Shirley, ma'am, that it's real mean not to tell me when we've all been such chums.  <sub>[v2 c28 P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047)</sub>

> I've got an aunt who has been married three times and says she married the first time for love and the last two times for strictly business, and was happy with all three except at the times of the funerals. But I think she took a resk, Miss Shirley, ma'am.  <sub>[v2 c28 P67](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0067)</sub>

> A wedding ain't much cheerfuller than a funeral after all, when it's all over, Miss Shirley, ma'am.  <sub>[v2 c28 P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075)</sub>
